dog.description_text:
AGE / WEIGHT: 3 years old / 60 lbs

GENDER: Male

ENERGY: Moderate

GOOD WITH: Dogs - Yes, Kids - Yes, Cats - TBD

ABOUT ME: Every morning I bounce out of my crate like it’s championship day, because honestly, it might be. I’m gentle, goofy, and a little clumsy, and I’m a total dog person: I aced my first day of daycare and I’ll happily play with your pup. Once a day I raid the toy bin and prance around, not caring when a toy whacks me in the face. I’m also a fast learner. Sit on the elevator, get a treat? Already mastered.

MY FOSTER SAYS: "He figured out that when he sits on the elevator he gets treats. Yesterday there was a stranger who got on behind us and OG walked over and sat in front of him waiting for his reward."

HISTORY

From Georgia; showed up as a stray at the home of a rescue volunteer and was so nice they immediately took him in. OG traveled north to Brooklyn in mid-September 2026.

DETAILED PROFILE

OG Anunoby greets every morning like it’s opening night at the Garden. He bounces out of his crate ready to go, and his good mood is contagious. He’s goofy, gentle, a little clumsy, and eager to please, with moderate energy split between cuddling up to relax and a daily burst of play. That burst usually starts at the toy bin, where he picks something he can shake and prances around while it smacks him in the face.

He’s also one of the most polite dogs his foster has met. He watches, figures out the rules, and waits for permission. Once he learned that sitting on the elevator earns a treat, he started offering a sit to every rider, strangers included. He greets people calmly and has never needed correcting for jumping. On leash he’s a gem, walking right at your side nearly all the time.

Other dogs are his favorite thing. He loves running and playing with his foster’s dogs and earned great reviews for gentle play at daycare. He seems happiest with canine company, so another dog in the home would be a real bonus. He’s been gentle and relaxed with the kids he’s met. His experience with cats isn’t known yet. He loves hikes and water but is not, for the record, a running buddy.

He's crate trained and hangs out there on his own. His house training is heading in the right direction, with no accidents lately, even on a trip out of town. He’s calm in the car, too.

For anyone who wants an underrated, do-it-all teammate with a championship-level morning attitude, OG is ready for tip-off.

MEDICAL HISTORY

The dogs in our care are up-to-date on vaccinations, spayed or neutered (when old enough), microchipped, and given a general health check. Immediate medical needs and medical history will be addressed with the adopter prior to adoption. Complete vet records will be sent shortly after adoption.
dog.name: OG Anunoby
